title: Policy Values Administration Terms: Loan Offset Against Whole Life Insurance Values
content:
**Product:** Whole Life Insurance (all Ashgrove tiers).

## Terms

When a policy loan is extinguished against the policy values on the insured's death, on the application of a nonforfeiture option or on loan default, the whole loan principal as the policy ledger totals it, that is the loan advances and capitalized interest less the principal repaid and extinguished, is extinguished together with the loan interest accrued and unpaid on it, as one loan offset entry. A loan on a policy surrendered for cash is not extinguished by an offset entry, because the surrender payment itself deducts the loan and its interest.

The interest extinguished at an offset is fixed only after the policy ledger carries a capitalization entry for the most recent policy anniversary on which loan interest was owed.

Put the other way: while the policy ledger carries no capitalization entry for that anniversary, the interest extinguished at an offset is not yet a fixed amount.

| Occasion | Loan offset entry |
|---|---|
| Death of the insured | One entry: whole ledger principal and the unpaid accrued interest |
| A nonforfeiture option applied (reduced paid-up or extended term, by default or election) | One entry: whole ledger principal and the unpaid accrued interest |
| Loan default (indebtedness reached the cash value) | One entry: whole ledger principal and the unpaid accrued interest |
| Surrender for cash | No offset entry |

## Invocation: `extinguish_policy_loan_1349795c`

**Capability.** Extinguishes the policy loan of one Ashgrove whole life policy against the policy's own values on the occasion that ends or converts the coverage. One call books a single loan offset entry dated today that records the loan principal and the accrued loan interest extinguished together, and lowers the policy's loan balance by the principal extinguished.

**How it is invoked.** This is an agent-side tool. Unlock it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool`, then call it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `whole_policy_id` | The reference number of the whole life policy whose loan is extinguished, as returned by the whole life policy lookup for the verified owner | Identifier, as recorded |
| `offset_reason` | The occasion of the offset | Exactly one of the enum values below |
| `principal_amount` | The loan principal extinguished, which is the whole loan balance shown on the policy including capitalized interest | US dollars, 2 decimal places |
| `interest_amount` | The loan interest accrued and unpaid that is extinguished with the principal | US dollars, 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent before it is passed |

Values of `offset_reason`:

- `surrender` — a loan extinguished when the policy is surrendered for cash, an occasion Ashgrove now settles inside the surrender payment, so the value appears only on older entries;
- `death_claim` — the settlement of a death claim on the insured;
- `nonforfeiture` — the policy going onto reduced paid-up or extended term insurance, by default or by the owner's election;
- `loan_default` — the termination of the policy because indebtedness reached its cash value.

**Return.** A receipt with `offset_id` (the reference of the new offset entry), `whole_policy_id`, `offset_reason` (the occasion recorded), `principal_extinguished` and `interest_extinguished` (2 decimal places each), `offset_date` (YYYY-MM-DD, the date of the entry) and `loan_balance_after` (the loan balance left on the policy, 2 decimal places). A receipt carrying an `offset_id` means the offset was booked.
